content: Diospa Causac shimi nishcamanda

Callari uras imahuas chara mana tiyashcallaita, Jesucristoga Causac Shimi nishca tiyagashca. Ñáa Causac Shimi Dioshuan pariu causac ashca, paillatami Dios ashca. Paillatami Diospa Shimi nishcahuas an Yaya Dios imasna acta ñucanchita ricuchishcamanda.
Chasna callari uras imatahuas chara mana rashcallaitami ña paihua yayahuan pariu tiyac aushca.
Paimandami tucui tiyangaraushcaguna callarishcauna Yaya Dios rashcagunaga anaushca. Cai Shimi illashca acpiga mana imas raitucunmachara.
Tucui rashcagunaga cai Shimimandami causaita charinaura, pai quiquin causaimi punzhashina runagunataga Yaya Dios imasna acta ricuchira.
Cai punzhami ansa ucuibi punzhayachishcashina juchaibi causac runagunataga tucuita pagllai ricuchiun. Chi ansa tutaicuinta puriu runagunaga mana punzhata munashallata binsinata mana ushashcaunachu.
Shuc punzha Juan nishca runataga Dios cachara.
Paiga cai punzhayachigmanda sirtuta rimac shamura. Cai mundui auc runagunata yachachiura tucui runaguna pai rimashcata uyasha Jesucristo punzha acta quirinauchun nisha.
Juanga mana chi punzhayachicchashca, randi cai punzhayachigmandami yachachingahua cachashca runa mara.
Ñáa Causac Shimi nishcaga cai pachama shamura punzhayachishcashina tucui runaguna Diosta yuyarisha quirinauchun nisha.
Cai Diospa Shimi agmi munduibi aura. Yaya Dios cai munduta paihuanllatami pariu rashca agllaitami, cai mundui auc runagunaga mana ricsinaushcachu.
Paihua quiquin runagunama shamugllaita mana llaquinaurachu.
Randi paita llaquisha quiriccunataga ushaita cura quiquin Diospa runaguna nishca tucungahua.
Paigunaga mana runa miraimandachu, mana runa munaimandachushina tucunaun, randi Diospa ushaimandallami paihua runaguna tucunaun.
Cai Causac Shimiga aichayuc tucuc shamusha ñucanchihuan pariu causaura. Paiga yapa llaquic, sirtutas rimac ara. Diospa shuglla churi actas, paishinallata ushaiyuc sumac actahuas ricushcanchi.

Paimanda Juanga rimara casna, Paiga ñuca cangunata rimashca man. Ñáucahuasha shamucca ñucamandas mas yali balic man ñaupamandapacha causac ashcaraicu nishcani. Chasna nisha paimandami cangunataga cuintac arani.
Tucui imatas pai charishami ñucanchita yapa llaquishami imatas cun. Chasna acpimi tucui tunu aligunata catin catin ashcata japiunchi.
Yaya Diosca pai mandashcagunata ñaupa causac Moisesma cucpi ñucanchima pasachira. Randi Dios ñucanchita llaquiushcataga chasnallata sirtu shimitahuas Jesucristo ricuchun nisha cachara.
Mana pihuas Yaya Diostaga ima uraspas ricushcachu, randi paihuan pariu causac sapalla churillata ñucanchitaga ricsichishcami.
Bautisac Juanga Jesucristomanda mas riman

Ñáa shuc punzha Juanda can pitangui nisha tapugringahua, israel amugunaga cachanaura maican israel pagrigunatas, chasnallata paigunata yanapac Leví muntunmanda runagunatas Jerusalenmanda Juanbagma cachanaura tapunauchun nisha.
Tapucpi Juan pagllai rimara, Ñáucaga mana quishpichic Cristochani.

Cutillata tapunaura, Mana chasna ashaga pitangui, Dios rimashcata pasachic ñaupa causac Elias nishca runachangui nicpi Juan cutipara mana paichani. Mas tapusha ninaura, Dios cachangaraushca pai rimashcata pasachic runa changui nisha tapucpi mana paihuaschani nira.
Nicpi cuti tapunaura, Chasna ashaga pitanguiya. Imatata nigrishun ñucanchitas cachac fariseogunamaga.
Chasna nicpi Juanga Dios rimashcata pasachic runa Isaias rimashca shimitacuintallata paigunata nira:

content.text: Ñáucaga chaquishca pambaibi casna caparisha camachini:
canguna causaita alichirichi nisha rimac runa ani.

content: Ñáa maican tapuccunaga fariseo cachashca runaguna manaura.
Paigunaga cutillata tapunaura, Can mana quishpichic Cristo ashaga, mana ñaupa causac Elias ashaga, mana Dios rimashcata pasachic runa ashaga, imahuata bautisaungui.
Juan randi cutipara, Yacullahuanmi ñucaga bautisauni, randi canguna ucullaitami aun shuc canguna mana ricsishca runa.
Paiga ñucahuasha shamuc ashallatami mas balicchani tucunga. Ñáucaga astahuan paihua zapatosta pascangallahuas mas ucui rauc runa ani nira.
Ñáa chasna tapuc shamunaura Jordan yacu chimbai, Betania nishca llactai Juan bautisaushca partibi.
Jesusca Yaya Dios cachashca quishpichic nishca
Cayandi punzha Juanbagma Jesus caillayamuuta ricusha ricuichi nira, Caimi Dios ovejatashina cachashca runa an, paimi tucui juchagunatas pichac an.
Paimandami cangunata cuintasha casna nirani, Ñáucahuasha shamucca ñucamandas mas balic man pai ñaupamandapacha causac ashcaraicu.
Ñáucahuas mana yacharanichu maican actahuas, chasna agllaita yacuhuan bautisashalla purini israel runaguna paita ricsinauchun nisha.
Juan chasnallata rimarami, Ricushcanimi Diospa Samaita jahuapachamanda shuc palomashina uraicumusha paihua jahuai tiyaricta.

Ñáuca chara mana yacharanichu maican actas. Randi yacuhuan bautisachun nisha ñucata cachac Diosmi ñaupata paimanda nihuara, ñuca Samai uraicusha shuc runa jahuaibi tiyaricta ricunguimi, paimanga runagunata ñuca Samaihuan bautisangarauc runaga.
Ñáucami chitaga ña ricushcani, chiraicumi cangunata nini, paimi sirtupacha Diospa churi an nisha.
Jesusta punda catic runaguna
Cayandi punzha Juan chillaita aura ishcai (2) paita catiu runagunahuan.
Jesus pasauta ricusha paigunata nira, Ricuichi, paimi Dios cachamushca quishpichiccuna an.
Chasna chi ishcandi Juanda catic runagunami pai rimashcata uyasha Jesusta catinaura.
Chasna catisha rinaupi Jesus bulltiarisha ricusha tapura, Imatata mascaunguichi nicpi paiguna ninaura, Maibita causangui rabí. (Hebreo shimibi “rabí” nishaga runa shimibi yachachic ninmi).
Jesus cutipasha ricucshamuichi nicpi risha pai tiyashcata ricusha chi punzha paihuan cainanaura, las cuatro tupugama.
Chi ishcandimi Jesusmanda Juan rimashcata uyasha Jesusta caticpuramanda shucca arami Simon Pedrohua huauqui Andres nishca.
Andresca chara mana imatas rashallata paihua huauqui Simonda mascasha tupashcaibi nira, Mesiasta, Dios cachashca quishpichic Cristotami tupashcanchi. (Paiguna shimibi “Mesias” nisha Cristo ninmi).

Chihuasha Andres paihua huauqui Simonda Jesuspagma apara. Pactacpi Jesus Simonda ricusha nira, Canga Juanba churi Simon mangui, randi cunanga camba shuti angami Cefas nishca, (“Cefas” nisha griego shimibi Pedro nin, chitaga runa shimibi rumi nin).
Jesus cayan Felipeta Natanaeltahuas
Ñáa cayandi punzha Jesus Galilea nishca partima rinata yuyarira. Risha Felipeta tupasha paita, ñucata catihuai nira.
Cai Felipega Betsaida nishca llactamanda mara, chasnallata Andrespas, Pedrondi chimandallata manaura.

Felipega Natanaelta mascasha tupagrisha casnami cuintara, Uyai, Moises mandashca shimibi quillcashca runataga tuparanchimi, Dios rimashcata pasachic runagunahuas paimandami rimanaushca. Paiga Nazaret llactamanda Josehua churi Jesus man.
Caita uyasha Natanael nira, Imasata Nazaretmandaga angaya. Nazaretmanda imallahuas ali llucshimucca mana tiyanzhu nicpi Felipe paita cutipara, Canllata ricucshamui nira.
Natanael caillayamuuta ricusha Jesus paimanda rimara, Caibimi shamuun shuc sirtupacha israel runa, paiga mana llullac runachan.
Jesus chasna nicpi Natanael tapura, Imasata can ñucata ricsihuangui. Tapucpi Jesus cutipara, Felipe chara mana cuintagllaita candaga ricurani, can higo nishca ruya sapibi aushcaibi.
Chita uyasha Natanael cutipasha nira, Sirtupacha canmi Diospa churiga angui señor, canmi israel llactata mandac gubirnuga angui.
Jesus randi paita nira, Higo ruya sapibi shayaushcallaitami canda ricuranimi nicpichu quirihuangui. Caimandahuas mas jatun rashcagunatahuasmi ricungaraungui.
Chasnallata Jesus nirami, Sirtupacha cangunata nini ricunguichimi jahuapacha pascarishcata, Diospa angelgunatahuas Runa Tucucpa jahuaibi sicasha uraicusha raucunata ricuhuangaraunguichimi nira.
